description: vite-plugin-node. Vite and vite-plugin-node majors arrive in one PR. Extend after default.

packageRules.description: vite-plugin-node and Vite are a peer-bound Lockstep set: each vite-plugin-node major supports one Vite major (7 needs vite ^7, 8 needs vite ^8), so either major alone fails install under strict peer dependencies. Minors and patches are already grouped by default.
